'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good afternoon, young man. Tarkov has endured a humanitarian crisis for far too many years. I'm sure you understand that civilians need places where they can shelter from both Scavs and mercenaries. I've done everything I can to help them, but lately that has become increasingly difficult. Could you obtain the keys to several locations I have identified? My people will be able to establish safe havens there for those in need.}}

==Objectives==
* Obtain 1 [[Dorm room 303 key|Dorm room 303 key]]
* Obtain 1 [[ZB-014 key|ZB-014 key]]
* Obtain 1 [[Military checkpoint key|Military checkpoint key]]
* Obtain 1 [[Gas station storage room key]]
* Hand over 1 [[Dorm room 303 key|Dorm room 303 key]]
* Hand over 1 [[ZB-014 key|ZB-014 key]]
* Hand over 1 [[Military checkpoint key|Customs military checkpoint key]]
* Hand over 1 [[Gas station storage room key]]

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Therapist]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.25'''</font>
* 165,000 Roubles
** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Wonderful! Happy to work with you again, you have gained my trust once more.}}
